score_reasons.quality: Cinematic sports-photography look with sharp facial detail, sweat sheen, realistic flag fabric, credible packed-crowd bokeh, floodlight flare and blue-black smoke; high contrast is well controlled with no banding or upscaling mush. Minor deductions for slightly muddled finger/fabric merging in the viewer-left grip and generic club crest rendering.
score_reasons.aesthetics: Strong movie-poster composition: low heroic angle, figure centered as the core, title layered behind the head with good depth separation; blue/black kit echoes the smoke and stand colors; the scream conveys passion. The chaotic pseudo-lettering at top and mid-poster cheapens the otherwise premium look.
score_reasons.alignment: Scene elements largely delivered: player celebrating at midfield with arms raised and flag draped over shoulders, passionate roaring expression, packed stands, spotlights, blue-black smoke, confetti, and crowd flags with a Champions-League-style starball banner; knee-up framing satisfies half-to-full body. Misses: the main title is misspelled BASITONI instead of BASTONI; an extra garbled tagline line above the title violates the no-micro-print/limited-typography constraint; the flag is not the required Bosnia and Herzegovina design; stadium is generic rather than recognizably San Siro; exact five-finger count is unverifiable since both hands are closed fists.
score_reasons.real_world_fidelity: Multiple real-world checks fail: the draped flag mixes a red field with a yellow star (China-like) and a blue field with an oversized yellow star, lacking Bosnia and Herzegovina's yellow triangle and diagonal white stars; the title misspells the player's name; the jersey sponsor is garbled pseudo-text; the shirt number 10 does not match the player's real squad number; the crest is an approximation rather than the actual club mark.
score_reasons.creative_generation: The poster energy is genuinely dramatic — diagonal flag wings frame the figure, confetti and smoke create layered depth, and the title-figure stacking shows competent poster craft; however three separate garbled text zones destroy the professional billing and undercut the design execution.
